g.text: MyNetMate - Web client / server interface contracts
Three INDEPENDENT revision pairs | URL-contract trace, not a merged system or E2E test
Network pair: website main 28ac37b / backend main 166e2ee
Configuration pair: website config-ui ad95634 / backend main 166e2ee
Identity pair: website auth-audit-ui 3e4d85c / backend audit-writer b862c60
Square = UML Port (name suppressed). Socket = required; ball = provided.
Each assembly joins two simple ports for ONE named interface.
role : ComponentType denotes a part; types are logical software-module abstractions.
Contract IDs map to operations and immutable source evidence in README / CONTRACTS.md.
Each frame is a separate client/server contract mapping under the configured API base URL.
All contracts have source call sites; matching paths alone do not prove runtime interoperability.
The Configuration HTTP boundary includes config routers and the devices detail / SSH endpoints.
No binding joins the three frames. No CIS UI or Dashboard data service is invented.
